verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair axis for an analytics platform, but the evidence pack never documents retention settings or a user or event data deletion capability. The cited Taxonomy API deletes schema definitions such as event types and properties, not collected user data. Session Replay masking and the shared consent model control what gets captured, not how long data is kept or how it is erased, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
